title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant - Harrogate

Hybrid

Salary: Up to £32,000

Hours: 40 per week (full-time)

Are you an Accounts Assistant who wants more variety than just processing invoices?

Do you enjoy being hands-on with transactional finance but also want to get involved in month-end and reconciliations?

We're working with a well-established business in Harrogate that has grown steadily over the years and built a reputation for looking after its people. The finance team is experienced, friendly and highly experienced, so you'll be learning from some of the best, while also having the autonomy to take ownership of your own workload.

This isn't a role where you'll be pigeon-holed. You'll have the chance to broaden your skills across purchase and sales ledger, support with accruals, prepayments and journals over time, and play a part in making sure the finance function runs smoothly month after month. It's a brilliant step for someone who's confident with the basics but wants to grow into a more rounded finance role and pick up some month end tasks.

What's in it for you?
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays
- Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 from home
- Paid volunteering days
- Discounts via Perkbox and from retailers
- A supportive and experienced finance team to learn from

What you'll be doing:
- Processing purchase and sales invoices
- Raising purchase orders and ensuring accuracy across ledgers
- Reconciling accounts, resolving discrepancies and supporting with supplier payments
- Assisting with accruals, prepayments, journals and other key month-end activities
- Maintaining control schedules and ensuring compliance with finance timetables and policies
- Performing monthly reconciliations of banking and client records
- Acting as the first point of contact for internal and external finance queries
- Working closely with suppliers and other departments to resolve issues quickly and effectively
- Supporting credit control during busy periods and assisting with ad-hoc finance tasks

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience in a purchase ledger or accounts assistant role with exposure to invoice processing and reconciliations
- Someone detail-focused, organised and proactive, with a genuine interest in broadening their finance knowledge
- Strong communication skills for building relationships across teams and with external suppliers
- Competent with accounting systems and Excel
- Ideally studying towards AAT (or equivalent) and looking to build a career in finance, qualified by experienced candidates will absolutely be considered

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who's ready to take the next step in their finance career, you'll gain exposure across the whole accounts function, work in a supportive environment, and have the chance to shape your development alongside an experienced finance team.

For further information please reach out to me for a chat

title: Care & Support Coordinator
description:
Care & Support Coordinator

Location: Harrogate

Salary: £16.10 per hour

Are you organised, proactive and passionate about delivering high-quality, person-centred care? We would love to hear from you!

We are recruiting for a Care & Support Coordinator to provide cover across weekdays, evenings and weekends. We welcome applications from candidates seeking either full-time or part-time employment.

Whether you are looking for full-time hours, part-time work, we would be pleased to hear from you.

About the Role

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Care & Support Coordinator to join our team and play a key role in the effective planning and delivery of our care and support services.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in social care who enjoys coordinating people, supporting staff and ensuring customers receive high-quality, consistent and personalised care.

Working closely with the Manager, Deputy Manager, staff, customers, families and other professionals, you will support the smooth day-to-day running of the service, ensuring that care and support are effectively coordinated and individual needs are met.

You will play an important role in ensuring the right staff are in the right place at the right time, while promoting a person-centred approach that places customers' rights, choices, wishes and independence at the heart of everything we do.

Key Responsibilities

Care Planning and Coordination
- Plan, book and coordinate care and support visits.
- Coordinate and manage staff rotas, ensuring appropriate staffing levels and cover across the service.
- Allocate staff to customers, taking account of individual needs, staff skills, experience, location and compatibility.
- Ensure all rota changes are updated promptly and accurately on the rostering system.
- Assess and process referrals and coordinate the onboarding of new customers.
- Develop, review and maintain customer support plans and risk assessments.
- Maintain effective communication with customers, families, staff and other professionals involved in the delivery of care and support.

Service Quality and Staff Support
- Support the Manager with the effective day-to-day running of the care and support service.
- Promote and monitor the delivery of high-quality, personalised care and support.
- Undertake spot checks and staff supervisions as required.
- Support recruitment and selection activities.
- Manage staff absence procedures, including conducting return-to-work interviews.
- Promote a positive, supportive and professional working environment.

Operational Responsibilities
- Respond to emergency call bells and provide background support when working at St Roberts Grove.
- Provide cover for care and support calls when required.
- Participate in an out-of-hours on-call rota.
- Attend staff meetings, supervision sessions and training as required.
- Promote a positive image of the organisation, its work and values.
- Maintain compliance with organisational policies and procedures, including relevant health and safety requirements.

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking someone who is proactive, reliable and well organised, with the ability to manage competing priorities, use their initiative and work effectively as part of a team.

You will have good communication and administrative skills, an understanding of the social care sector and the confidence to coordinate staff and respond effectively to the changing needs of the service.

Essential Requirements

Skills and Competencies
- Good verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to plan, organise and coordinate staff rotas effectively.
- Strong administrative skills and good computer literacy.
- Ability to maintain accurate records and follow statutory reporting procedures.
- Ability to understand, implement and follow policies, procedures and instructions.

Experience
- Experience of working within the social care sector.
- Previous experience of coordinating staff rotas.

Qualifications and Knowledge
- Minimum Level 2 qualification in Health and Social Care, with a willingness to work towards Level 3.
- Knowledge of health and safety within care services, including risk assessment and management.
- Understanding of safeguarding, including the ability to recognise signs of abuse and follow the appropriate reporting procedures.

Additional Requirements
- Willingness to work flexibly to meet the changing needs of the service.
- Commitment to keeping knowledge, skills and professional practice up to date.
- Willingness to undertake an Enhanced DBS check.

Desirable Requirements
- Experience of staff management or supervision.
- Experience of using care management or rostering systems.
- Full, valid UK driving licence.

What We Offer

This is an opportunity to make a real difference to the lives of the people we support while developing your skills and experience within a rewarding social care environment.

You will be joining a team that is committed to promoting independence, dignity, choice and high-quality, person-centred care.

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion

We are committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community.

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Disability Action Yorkshire, please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Commercial Property & Corporate Legal Assistant
company: Clear Legal & Financial Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
A fantastic opportunity has arisen for two experienced Legal Assistants to join a busy and expanding Commercial Property & Corporate department, with one position based in Harrogate and the other in Skipton.

The successful candidates will provide comprehensive administrative and legal support to fee earners, helping to ensure matters are managed efficiently and clients receive a high standard of service.

Previous Commercial Property experience is essential. Corporate experience would be an advantage, but is not essential.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to solicitors and fee earners.
- Managing client files and maintaining accurate records using a case management system.
- Preparing correspondence, documents and legal paperwork through audio typing, digital dictation and word processing.
- Managing diaries, arranging appointments and coordinating meetings.
- Handling incoming calls, emails and client enquiries professionally.
- Opening, organising and archiving legal files.
- Preparing client bills and maintaining account ledgers.
- Supporting Commercial Property transactions, including:

o Ordering property searches and completing client ID checks.

o Assisting with exchanges and completions.

o Liaising with the Land Registry and handling registrations.
- Supporting Corporate matters with document preparation, file management and general administrative duties.
- Preparing court documentation and electronic bundles where required.
- Providing general support to colleagues and the wider department.

Requirements
- Previous experience working as a Legal Assistant or Legal Secretary within a law firm.
- Commercial Property experience is essential and non-negotiable.
- Previous Corporate legal experience is desirable but not essential.
- Strong audio typing, word processing and document preparation skills.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and legal case management systems.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Confident communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Working Hours
- Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm.
- One-hour lunch break.

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established and growing legal practice offering a supportive working environment and the opportunity to develop within a busy specialist department.

Should you have any questions or wish to apply please do not hesitate to contact Clear Legal and Financial.

Please Note: Due to the number of applications we receive we may be unable to respond to every application directly. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days please assume your application has been unsuccessful.

title: Credit Controller - Harrogate
description:
Credit Controller - Harrogate

Up to £33,000 depending on experience

40 hours per week

Are you an experienced Credit Controller looking to join a friendly and supportive finance team where your contribution will make a real difference?

We're recruiting on behalf of a well-established business in Harrogate that is looking to strengthen its finance team with the addition of an experienced Credit Controller. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a successful organisation that prides itself on its collaborative culture and offers a varied role with plenty of autonomy.

You'll be responsible for managing your own ledger, maintaining strong customer relationships and ensuring payments are collected efficiently, while working closely with colleagues across the business to resolve queries and support the wider finance function.

Duties and responsibilities will include:
- Managing your own portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring outstanding invoices are collected in a timely manner
- Chasing overdue payments by telephone and email while maintaining positive customer relationships
- Investigating and resolving invoice and payment queries
- Allocating incoming payments and maintaining accurate customer account records
- Producing customer statements and supporting the sales ledger function
- Monitoring aged debt and escalating any concerns where appropriate
- Liaising with internal departments to resolve account discrepancies
- Assisting with bank reconciliations and cash allocation
- Supporting month-end activities and providing assistance to the wider finance team when required

To be considered for this role you will:
- Have previous experience working within a Credit Control role, managing the end-to-end credit control process
- Be confident communicating with customers and negotiating payment solutions professionally
- Have excellent organisational skills and be able to manage your workload effectively
- Possess strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving
- Be comfortable using finance systems and have a good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- Enjoy working as part of a team while also being able to work independently

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career within a supportive business that values its people.

Offering a salary of up to £33,000 depending on experience and based in Harrogate, this role would suit an experienced Credit Controller who enjoys taking ownership of their ledger and making a positive impact within a supportive finance team. The company have free onsite parking, good transport links and are accessible from Harrogate, Wetherby, Knaresborough and Leeds

title: Legal Secretary & Office Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Legal Secretary & Office Coordinator
Location: Harrogate
Salary: £27,000 - £30,000 per annum
Hours: Full-time, Monday - Friday

Are you an organised and proactive individual with legal secretarial experience looking for your next opportunity?

We are currently recruiting for a Legal Secretary & Office Coordinator to join a professional and friendly business based in Harrogate. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied role, combining legal secretarial support with general office coordination and administration.

You will play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the office, ensuring that administrative tasks are completed efficiently and that the wider team receives a high standard of support.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is organised, enjoys working in a professional environment and takes pride in delivering an efficient and reliable service.

Your duties as Legal Secretary & Office Coordinator:
- Provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to the legal team.
- Prepare, format and amend legal documents, correspondence and reports.
- Manage diaries, appointments and meeting arrangements.
- Handle incoming calls, emails and general enquiries professionally.
- Maintain accurate filing systems and ensure documents are organised and accessible.
- Coordinate the day-to-day running of the office, ensuring everything operates smoothly.
- Welcome visitors and assist with meeting room arrangements.
- Manage office supplies and liaise with suppliers where required.
- Support with general office administration and other ad hoc duties.
- Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately.

Skills / qualifications required in order to be successful:
- Previous legal secretarial or legal administrative experience is required.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Confident written and verbal communication skills.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workloads effectively.
- Professional and approachable manner.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- A proactive attitude with a willingness to support the wider business.

In return as Legal Secretary & Office Coordinator, you will receive a competitive salary of £27,000 - £30,000 per annum, alongside the opportunity to join a professional and supportive working environment.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their career within a varied position, where they can utilise their legal secretarial skills whilst taking responsibility for wider office coordination and administration.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Sharp Consultancy are currently recruiting for a Payroll Administrator to join a business based in Harrogate on an ongoing temporary basis.

This is an immediate start opportunity, so we are particularly interested in candidates who are available to start straight away.

The successful candidate will support the payroll function, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing whilst providing administrative support across all aspects of payroll.

Key Responsibilities
- Preparing and inputting payroll data.
- Completing payroll reconciliations.
- Managing pension auto-enrolment and administration.
- Producing payroll reports.
- Calculating holiday pay.
- Responding to employee payroll queries.
- Carrying out National Minimum Wage checks.
- Processing starters and leavers.
- Updating employee banking details.

The Ideal Candidate
- Previous experience in payroll administration or payroll processing.
- Good understanding of payroll procedures.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- Ability to work to deadlines in a busy environment.
- Available to start immediately or at very short notice.

The Opportunity
- Salary equivalent of £30,000-£33,000.
- Ongoing temporary assignment.
- Based in Harrogate.
- Immediate start available.

If you have previous payroll experience and are available immediately, we'd love to hear from you.

Sharp Consultancy is a finance and accountancy recruitment specialist assisting accounting and finance divisions of businesses in the Yorkshire and Derbyshire area. With over 30 years' experience we pride ourselves on sourcing excellent finance professionals across all divisions of an accounts function.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK full time without restriction. To apply please send your CV to the e-mail address stated, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, we receive it is not always possible to respond to unsuccessful applicants. Therefore, if we have not responded to your application within seven days, please note that on this occasion your application has not been successful.
